name: AC Installation & Uninstallation
description: Professional split & window AC mounting, outdoor unit bracket fixing, copper pipe flare connection, vacuuming and electrical safety testing.

name: AC General Service
description: Comprehensive routine maintenance: air filter cleaning, cooling coil dusting, drain tray flushing, fan blower cleanup, and operational check.

name: AC Jet or Water Service
description: High-pressure water pump cleaning with spill-proof jacket bag. Washes out deep embedded dirt, mud, and dust from indoor cooling coils and outdoor condenser fins.

name: AC Foam Service
description: Specialized active foam wash that penetrates deep between cooling coil fins to dissolve oily grime, mold, mildew, and foul odors for pure, hygienic, ice-cold air.

name: AC Gas Leakage Detection & Repair
description: Nitrogen pressure testing and electronic leak detection to identify minute leaks in copper pipes, flare nuts, or cooling coils, followed by durable brazing.

name: AC Gas Refilling / Top-up
description: Full system evacuation, vacuuming with pump, and genuine refrigerant charging (R32, R410A, R22) to exact factory pressure for ice-cold cooling.
features: Complete deep vacuuming before gas fill

name: AC Water Leakage & Drain Repair
description: Resolves indoor unit water dripping, clogged drain lines, tilted indoor units, and cracked drain pans to protect your walls and furniture from damage.

name: Any AC Complaints & Breakdown Repair
description: Complete diagnostic for any issue: AC not turning on, compressor tripping, remote/sensor unresponsive, PCB circuit board failure, or abnormal rattling noises.

name: Refrigerator Not Cooling / Low Cooling
description: Quick doorstep troubleshooting when the freezer is working but the lower fridge is warm, or total loss of cooling across single and double-door refrigerators.

name: Refrigerator Gas Charging & Leak Repair
description: Pinpoint detection of pinhole capillary or evaporator leaks, vacuuming of sealed system, and precision refrigerant recharge (R134a, R600a).

name: Compressor & Motor Repair / Replacement
description: Diagnosis for clicking compressor, inverter compressor failure, relay/overload protector burnout, or condenser fan motor malfunction.
features: Relay & OLP replacement with OEM parts

name: Excess Ice Formation & Defrost Issue
description: Fixes heavy frost build-up in freezer, choked air vents, faulty defrost timer, bimetal thermostat, or thermal fuse in frost-free refrigerators.

name: Refrigerator Water Leakage
description: Stops water pooling inside vegetable crisper trays or leaking under the refrigerator caused by blocked drain tubes, cracked drip trays, or melted frost overflow.

name: General Maintenance & Any Fridge Complaints
description: Comprehensive checkup for strange buzzing noises, flickering light, door not closing tight, power tripping, PCB error codes, or temperature fluctuation.
features: All major brands (LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Godrej, Haier, etc.)

name: Window AC Installation & Servicing
description: Complete service for window air conditioners: wooden/iron frame fitting, heavy coil chemical wash, fan motor greasing, and refrigerant pressure check.

name: Desert & Commercial Water Cooler Service
description: Doorstep servicing for residential desert coolers and industrial water coolers: submersible water pump replacement, honeycomb cooling pad fitting, motor repair, and tank sanitization.

name: Central AC & Cassette Duct Service
description: Professional maintenance for ceiling cassette ACs, ductable units, and commercial VRV/VRF central cooling systems for showrooms, offices, and homes.
